actualVisualInspection.method: Root explicitly adopted independent physical review of four complete new source figures and exact original32 preservation, fresh6component ownership/polygon coverage. Root personally viewed the unchanged original32 in prior adoption.

physicalReview.findings: Both new contact bodies are in wide crouched grounded lunges with two complete boots on one source baseline. Arms grip the HF blade in front of the upper torso; blade inclines upward toward the opponent. Cloak, mechanical pale limbs, straps, boots and pale hair follow this personalized Survive concept. The torso/pelvis axis lies within the planted base rather than following the raised blade bounding center. This source avoids the former horizontal flying body attached to floor.
physicalReview.qualification: This source can represent a grounded rising sword contact. It does not depict literal actor takeoff, and is not certified as a retail MGS4 animation or canonical Survive outfit.
